name: One-Eighty Place: veteran housing help (SSVF)
description: VA-funded Supportive Services for Veteran Families (SSVF, grant 18-SC-069): case management, help keeping a home, rapid rehousing and short-term financial help for low-income veteran households. Serves: Aiken County, Allendale County, Bamberg County, Barnwell County, Beaufort County, Berkeley County, Calhoun County, Charleston County, Chester County, Colleton County, Dorchester County, Fairfield County and 8 more.
next_step: Call SSVF intake with your county and housing situation: whether you are homeless now or at risk of losing housing, and who lives with you. A second intake number is listed: 803-726-6348.
constraints: Serves only the areas listed; check that yours is included. Veteran-household, income and housing-status screening applies.
County and intake details come from VA’s FY26 SSVF provider intake list; confirm current service when calling.
